title: 268쪽 · 5-Betting in Position
paragraphs: Live regs rarely 4-bet/fold when stacks are 100bb. Thus, you can have a 5-betting range at that stack depth. However, you should choose to flat your entire continuing range around 200bb. There are very few live pros willing to call off 150bb+ with less than K-K.

In fact, most of them will stop 4-betting Q-Q and A-K after seeing a 5-bet all-in for that many big blinds. They simply don’t want to deal with that kind of stack exposure. As a result, 5-betting at that stack depth becomes counterproductive.

You can flat 10-10+/A-Js+/A-Q and suited connectors if stacks are really deep. Flatting K-K+ insulates the rest of your range and makes you very difficult to play against. People have no idea if you have 5-4s or A-A.

Your range is uncapped on almost every board. Use that extra board coverage to generate fold equity in spots that most players can't target. You have so much more leverage that it is very difficult to profitably 4-bet me out of position when stacks are ultra deep.

100bb specialists fall for this trap every time. They have their little cookie cutter strategies for grinding 400NL on PokerStars. Put them '" 4 deep stack game and they crumble immediately, They don’t have enoug uations. Even worse, they have the heart, commitment, and mental fortitude to make a big call eat in the day, lose, and grind out of loss.
